label: RULING-wme-v2b A7 magnitude calibration (static member only; never WM-CP)
registered_rule: common random numbers: the same 16 calibration replicates (seeds CAL_SEED0 + 300..315) at every kappa in {0.80, 0.85, 0.90, 0.95, 1.00, 1.10}; kappa* by linear interpolation (or extrapolation) between the two grid points whose pooled median static held-out SE-scaled |error| (h = 3-4) is nearest the target; registered to two decimals

exploratory.note: earlier grids with different replicates per kappa (4-12 each); between-replicate variation made the pooled curve non-monotone (0.93: 2.58 on 12 replicates vs 1.00: 2.31 on 4), so the registered value uses common random numbers
